newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Trading plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Trading plans rights issue.

text.p: The Cyprus Trading Corporation plans a rights issue to raise about 1.5 million pounds ($2.9 million) as part of its expansion drive, the company announced on Friday.
The group plans to issue about 1.5 million shares on the basis of one for every 15 ordinary shares, partly paid shares or warrants held, or one for every 33.75 convertible bonds held.

Market sources said the capital-raising programme was needed to aid the expansion drive after the company clinched the dealership in Cyprus for Kraft Jacobs Suchard (KJS), a leading chocolate manufacturer which is a unit of Philip Morris Inc.

The rights shares, which have a nominal value of one pound each, will be issued to shareholders on the company register on July 19, 1997. Payment date for the shares is July 4. They are eligible for the seven cents dividend payable the same month.
The company said trading of the shares will start on the Cyprus stock exchange as soon as the bourse approves the transactions.
Cyprus Trading imports and distributes a large range of consumer items from luxury cars and electric goods to foodstuffs.
